confirmed: Fresh browser session verified Brief save, approval gate, asset task creation, image task authorization boundary, calendar creation/confirmation, refresh recovery, no console errors, and no content-panel overflow.
539 API tests passed with 59 environment-gated skips and 21 frontend contract tests passed.

Real temporary FastAPI plus Chrome/CDP gate passed authenticated content and calendar route checks, Brief approval, image task needs_authorization, calendar confirmation, responsive layout, console-error, and external-request boundaries.

The same real gate now reloads the content and calendar views and confirms the approved Brief, asset task, confirmed calendar item, and server-synchronization state are restored from authenticated server facts.

Obsidian service and HTTP tests cover authentication, allowed-vault enforcement, empty-scope whole-vault selection, Windows path normalization, deduplication, scope isolation, note limits, read-only response shape, and body redaction.

The real FastAPI/Chrome gate now connects a synthetic Obsidian vault, renders the note index, verifies refresh recovery, confirms the note body marker is absent from the API response and DOM, and returns 11/11 true.

The dashboard now requests project, GEO, content, and calendar summaries in parallel; configured GEO snapshots, content asset counts, and confirmed calendar items are surfaced with explicit unavailable states when a connector is not configured.
Frontend syntax and the 21-test Node suite pass after the dashboard aggregation change; the WB-04 real FastAPI/Chrome gate remains 11/11 true.
GitHub Actions run 33294764393 static-checks passed; its runtime job reached PostgreSQL, server tests, and browser cutover successfully before failing in legacy restore object-reference comparison.
The local follow-up commit b288e3f scopes restored object-reference verification to the committed project, and local targeted checks pass.

GitHub Actions run 33295746717 confirmed static checks, PostgreSQL initialization, server tests, and browser cutover, then exposed a second unscoped reference reader in the orphan-cleanup gate; local commit e574ba0 now scopes that reader by the committed projectId and adds a regression assertion.

GitHub Actions run 33296505246 passed both static-checks and m1-01-runtime after the orphan-cleanup reader was corrected to the workspace/client scope in commit 969b8b8; restore, orphan cleanup, and connection-loss gates all passed.
limitations: The authenticated server store is now the primary persistence path; browser localStorage remains an explicitly labelled offline-draft fallback when the API is unavailable.
No image is generated until a configured model connector is authorized; no external channel publishing is implemented.
The Obsidian integration is read-only metadata/index synchronization only; it does not expose note bodies, support note citations, or write back to the vault.
The production default vault is the configured local path and can be overridden with MARKETOPS_OBSIDIAN_VAULT_ROOT; browser gates use only a synthetic temporary vault.

Project/GEO/research task aggregation, real image connector execution, external channel publishing, and independent non-implementer review remain open; this engineering gate is not a customer-value, ROI, or production-readiness claim.
